SETUP_TOKEN.description: A long random string, for example from `openssl rand -hex 24`. It opens the first setup of the dashboard one time. Keep it until the setup is done.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Generate it with `openssl rand -hex 32`. It signs the click tracking links and the dashboard sessions.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Optional, but without it each step is manual. A [Cloudflare API token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with these permissions: **Email Sending Edit**, **Zone Read**, **Queues Edit**, **Access: Apps and Policies Edit**, **Workers Scripts Edit**.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: The ID of the account of `CF_API_TOKEN`.

AUTH_MODE.description: Leave it empty for Cloudflare Access (the default). Set `password` only for an account without Zero Trust.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Only for `AUTH_MODE=password`: the dashboard password. The password login also needs `SESSION_SECRET`. Leave it empty for Cloudflare Access.

WORKER_NAME.description: The name of this Worker. Change it if you change the Worker name in this form.

EVENTS_QUEUE_NAME.description: The name of the events queue. Change it if you change the name of the `fullsend-events` queue in this form.
